snippet.title: How Smart Seniors Use ChatGPT Without Getting Mentally Lazy
snippet.description:
If you are using ChatGPT, this video may be one of the most important things you learn about AI.

A recent study found that people who relied on ChatGPT the most actually remembered less and used less mental effort while learning. So does that mean AI is making us mentally lazy?

Not necessarily.

In this video, I show seniors and retirees how to use ChatGPT the RIGHT way so it helps you stay mentally sharp instead of replacing your thinking.

We talk about:
• How AI can quietly reduce critical thinking
• Why “easy answers” are not always real learning
• The difference between using ChatGPT as a helper vs depending on it completely
• Three common mistakes people make with AI
• How to use ChatGPT to strengthen memory, curiosity, and decision-making
• Practical prompts that encourage active thinking instead of passive scrolling

You will also learn simple ways to use ChatGPT for:
• comparing choices
• understanding technology
• learning new information
• asking better questions
• exercising your brain with quizzes and follow-up thinking

This video is designed specifically for older adults, beginners, retirees, and seniors who want to use AI tools like ChatGPT without losing independence, judgment, or mental sharpness.

At Smart Tech for Any Age, the goal is not just to teach technology. It is to help older adults use technology with confidence, wisdom, and common sense.

If you are new to ChatGPT, this video will help you build healthy habits from the beginning.

If you already use ChatGPT every day, this video may completely change the way you think about AI.
